key_highlights: ASX sheds $90bn in a week as rate-rise fears and oil price surge pressure miners and banks
Iron ore enters 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA flags rental inflation as key concern
Oil explodes as OPEC+ suppression fails; fuel prices to rise 30c in Australia
ANZ.AX post-3,500-job cuts faces long restructuring runway
Housing prices crash with first-home buyer surge; Leith Van Onselen warns of further falls
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals sector stress
Superannuation reform debate intensifies amid populist pressure

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners lead the $90bn index decline. Cap-raise activity surges as Canaccord-led mining dash for cash signals balance-sheet stress. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) show relative outperformance.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. Large-cap miners underperform; selective small-cap exploration names (Kuniko, Gateway WA) offer relative value. Avoid over-leveraged mid-caps.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields (10Y US at 4.94%) and rate fears pressure bank valuations. ANZ.AX restructuring post-3,500 job cuts faces execution risk. RBA rental inflation concern complicates policy path.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX face NIM pressure if RBA holds. Rising yields support bond portfolios but hurt equity multiples. ANZ.AX restructuring is a multi-quarter story.

sectors.trend: Positive. Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails; Australia softens local gas supply rules easing Asian fears. Santos preservation noted as strategic priority. Fuel prices to rise 30c domestically.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX), Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas policy flexibility. Oil surge supports upstream but raises input costs for downstream. Fuel price hike pressures consumer staples.

sectors.trend: Mixed-negative. Woolworths (WOW.AX) caught raising 'family staple' prices during Price Freeze promotion, damaging brand trust. Australian businesses report fear for future. Fuel cost pass-through pressures margins.
sectors.implications: WOW.AX, WES.AX face margin squeeze from 30c fuel rise. Consumer confidence deteriorating. Defensive positioning warranted.

sectors.trend: Negative. Housing prices crashing; no spring bounce at auctions. Leith Van Onselen forecasts further declines. First-home buyer surge is a lagging indicator. Property chiefs call for more migrants to address supply gap.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face occupancy and cap-rate pressure. Construction names (WTC.AX) may see delayed demand. Monitor RBA rental inflation data closely.

sectors.trend: Selective positive. ASX runners include Iondrive, Australasian, Aruma, Neurizon. AI theme (Anthropic IPO, Alibaba $10.2bn AI bet) drives global tech sentiment but limited direct ASX exposure.
sectors.implications: Small-cap momentum names offer tactical opportunities but carry high volatility. No major ASX-listed AI pure-plays; indirect exposure via CSL.AX diagnostics.

Commodity divergence: iron ore falling, oil surging, gold 'schmoulding'
AUD weakness on growth scare; implications for import costs and ASX foreign earnings
RBA policy dilemma: rental inflation vs growth slowdown
Australian housing correction deepening; supply-demand mismatch
Superannuation reform debate: populism vs system integrity
Mining sector cap-raise wave signals capital stress
Energy policy shift: gas supply rule relaxation, Santos strategic preservation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global rate shock / bond market stress
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge duration risk; favour short-duration credit; monitor 10Y US yield vs 4.94% level
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX exposure; rotate into oil/gold; monitor Chinese steel demand data
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid import-heavy retailers; consider AUD-hedged positions
Underweight REITs and construction; monitor RBA rental data; watch first-home buyer pipeline
Avoid pre-announcement small-cap miners; favour cash-flow-positive large caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy misstep on rental inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor RBA statements; position for potential hold or surprise hike; watch CPI rental component

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight energy: Santos and Woodside on gas policy flexibility and oil surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil price explosion plus relaxed gas supply rules create tailwind; Santos strategically preserved
PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources showing relative strength; gold-silver exploration (Kuniko, Gateway WA) benefits from safe-haven rotation

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Woolworths price-freeze breach highlights margin pressure; favour companies with genuine cost control

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; $90bn ASX loss driven by miners; Chinese demand weakness structural

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; 10Y yield at 4.94% signals bond market stress; Fed hike risk elevated
Housing prices crashing, no auction bounce, Van Onselen warns of further falls; rental inflation complicates RBA path

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid ANZ.AX near-term; wait for restructuring clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: 3,500 job cuts executed but 'grand plan has a long way to go'; execution risk over multiple quarters

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as iron ore weakness, oil-driven input costs, and AUD depreciation compound. Rate-rise fears from US (Fed 50bp signal, 10Y at 4.94%) create global risk-off. RBA rental inflation data is the key domestic catalyst. Expect volatility in materials and financials.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing correction may create entry points for REITs and construction in 6-12 months. Energy sector structurally supported by gas policy shift. Superannuation reform, if enacted, could boost long-term equity flows. Iron ore oversupply remains a headwind for miners through 2027.
key_catalysts: RBA statement on rental inflation and rate decision
US Fed 50bp hike decision and bond market reaction
Iron ore price floor test and Chinese stimulus signals
Australian CPI and housing data releases
